mhcII_status_5yr.label: MHC-II status, 5-year OS
mhcII_status_5yr.source: Johnson AM et al., J Thorac Oncol 2021;16:1694-1704, doi:10.1016/j.jtho.2021.05.004 (PMID 34048945): MHC-II high associated with improved overall survival, p = 0.046.
mhcII_status_5yr.note: Administratively censored at 1,825 days. The same split on full ~12-year follow-up is not significant (p = 0.29), so the effect is specific to the 5-year horizon. The paper does not name a horizon; the close numeric match is what suggests 5 years was its endpoint.

calibration.note: Outcome permuted across patients 1,000 times and the full screen re-run, so the band holds the correlation between features fixed. A theoretical uniform band would be wrong here: composition, niche and ΔG features are read off the same cells and are far from independent.

note: Overall survival. Recurrence endpoint omitted: time_to_recurrence_days has 58 missing values and a maximum of 41,830 days.
